snp4.10:1.1: Purābhedasutta. "Kathaṃdassī kathaṃsīlo upasanto ti vuccati, tam me Gotama pabrūhi pucchito uttamaṃ naraṃ". || ||
snp4.10:2.1: "Vitataṇho purā bhedā ti Bhagavā pubbam antam anissito vemajjhe nūpasaṃkheyyo, tassa n' atthi purekkhataṃ. || ||
snp4.10:3.1: Akkodhano asantāsī, avikatthī akukkuco, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, sa ve vācāyato muni. || ||
snp4.10:4.1: Nirāsatti anāgate atītaṃ nānusocati, vivekadassī phassesu diṭṭhīsu ca na niyyati, || ||
snp4.10:5.1: patilīno akuhako, apihālu amaccharī, appagabbho ajeguccho, pesuṇeyye ca no yuto, || ||
snp4.10:6.1: sātiyesu anassāvī atimāne ca no yuto, saṇho ca paṭibhānavā, na saddho na virajjati, || ||
snp4.10:7.1: lābhakamyā na sikkhati, alābhe na ca kuppati, aviruddho ca taṇhāya rase ca nānugijjhati, || ||
snp4.10:8.1: upekhako sadā sato na loke maññate samaṃ na visesī na nīceyyo, tassa no santi ussadā. || ||
snp4.10:9.1: Yassa nissayatā n' atthi, ñatvā dhammaṃ anissito bhavāya vibhavāya vā taṇhā yassa na vijjati, || ||
snp4.10:10.1: taṃ brūmi upasanto ti kāmesu anapekhinaṃ, ganthā tassa na vijjanti, atāri so visattikaṃ. || ||
snp4.10:11.1: Na tassa puttā pasavo vā khettaṃ vatthuṃ na vijjati,| attaṃ vā pi nirattaṃ vā na tasmiṃ upalabbhati. || ||
snp4.10:12.1: Yena naṃ vajju puthujjanā atho samaṇabrāhmaṇā, taṃ tassa apurekkhataṃ, tasmā vādesu n' ejati. || ||
snp4.10:13.1: Vītagedho amaccharī na ussesu vadate muni na samesu na omesu, kappaṃ n' eti akappiyo. || ||
snp4.10:14.1: Yassa loke sakaṃ n' atthi, asatā ca na socati, dhammesu ca na gacchati, sa ve santo ti vuccatī" ti || || PURĀBHEDASUTTAṂ
